analysis: The supplied change to docs/architecture/inference.md is documentation only. The patch shows a 'Last updated' date bump (line 3) and a new troubleshooting row near head line 3552 about a pre-release macOS 27.2 crash caused by SDK 27.2 Date comparisons. The excerpt is truncated and the added row text is incomplete. I examined the two head_text units (lines 1219-2016), which contain unchanged surrounding GLM5Next, calibration, deadline and prefix-cache text. Only lines 3 and 3552 are marked changed, so these units are context rather than modified content. The docs describe existing controls, including: GLM identity-chain weight-hash verification; the coordinator-to-provider SSE encryption path and its ChunkBatcher sink check; the SSD prefix-cache scoping and TTL (T-041); prompt-token caching scoped per prefix-cache scope; and startup calibration that is excluded from rates. None of this text changes code, configuration, trust boundaries, authorization, attestation, encryption or billing. It does not weaken any documented mitigation, and I found no contradiction with the T-041 threat model definition (30-minute TTL, HMAC-keyed names, account scope). Remaining uncertainty: the full patch for the new troubleshooting row at line ~3552 was not supplied, so its complete content is unreviewed, though a troubleshooting-table doc entry is unlikely to carry security impact. No findings.
